# Geo Explorer

> Interactive world map for searching cities and countries, viewing country
> boundaries, and looking up basic geographic data (population, coordinates).

Geo Explorer is a single-page client-side map app built with Leaflet. It has
no server-rendered pages or API beyond static JSON/GeoJSON data files.

## Data

- /data/cities.json: city name, country, region, population, coordinates
- /data/countries.json: country name, code, centroid coordinates
- /data/countries-boundaries.geojson: country border polygons

## Coverage

- Countries: all UN-recognized countries with centroid coordinates.
- Cities: major cities per country with population figures (source: public
  geographic datasets, not live/real-time data).

## Notes for agents

- Data is static and bundled at build time — it does not update in
  real time and should not be cited as current-day population.
- There is no search API; the site is a single HTML page with client-side
  search. To answer questions about a specific place, fetch
  /data/cities.json or /data/countries.json directly rather than trying to
  render the map.
